translations.literal: Pi seized the momentum and sortied; soldiers were each as one against a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Pi seized the momentum and sortied; soldiers were each as one against a hundred.

sentences.zh: 圍解，以功遷泗州刺史。

translations.literal: The siege was lifted; for merit he was transferred to prefect of Si.
translations.idiomatic: The siege was lifted; for merit he was transferred to prefect of Si.

sentences.zh: 在州十餘年，拜右金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: After more than ten years in the prefecture he was appointed general of the Right Golden Guard.
translations.idiomatic: After more than ten years in the prefecture he was appointed general of the Right Golden Guard.

sentences.zh: 詔未至，病卒。

translations.literal: The edict had not arrived when he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: The edict had not arrived when he died of illness.

sentences.zh: 貞元二十一年，贈尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Zhenyuan he was posthumously enfeoffed as vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Zhenyuan he was posthumously enfeoffed as vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 有子重政，軍吏欲立為郡將，重政母徐氏固拒不從。

translations.literal: He had a son Chongzheng; army officers wished to install him as commandery general, but Chongzheng's mother Lady Xu firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: He had a son Chongzheng; army officers wished to install him as commandery general, but Chongzheng's mother Lady Xu firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「前昭義軍泗州行營衙前兵馬使、大中大夫、試太子賓客、兼監察御史張重政，門有勛力，惟推義勇。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Former Zhaoyi Army Sizhou field headquarters front military horse commissioner, grand master of the court, acting mentor of the Heir Apparent and concurrently surveillance censor Zhang Chongzheng—his house has military merit and esteems only righteous courage.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Former Zhaoyi Army Sizhou field headquarters front military horse commissioner, grand master of the court, acting mentor of the Heir Apparent and concurrently surveillance censor Zhang Chongzheng—his house has military merit and esteems only righteous courage.

sentences.zh: 夙聞克家之美，常稱撫眾之才。

translations.literal: Long heard of the beauty of managing a household, constantly praised talent for comforting the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Long heard of the beauty of managing a household, constantly praised talent for comforting the multitude.

sentences.zh: 近者其父初亡，群小扇惑，誘以奇計，俾執軍麾。

translations.literal: Recently when his father first died, petty men incited and tempted with strange schemes to grasp the military baton.
translations.idiomatic: Recently when his father first died, petty men incited and tempted with strange schemes to grasp the military baton.

sentences.zh: 而重政與其母兄，號泣固拒，遂全懇願，奔告元戎，不為利回，成其先志。

translations.literal: Yet Chongzheng with his mother and elder brother wept and firmly refused, thus preserving earnest wish, ran to report the chief commander, not turned by profit, completing his father's will.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Chongzheng with his mother and elder brother wept and firmly refused, thus preserving earnest wish, ran to report the chief commander, not turned by profit, completing his father's will.

sentences.zh: 於家為孝子，在國為忠臣，軍政乂安，行義昭著。

translations.literal: Filial son in the family, loyal minister in the state—military government peaceful, conduct and righteousness illustrious.
translations.idiomatic: Filial son in the family, loyal minister in the state—military government peaceful, conduct and righteousness illustrious.

sentences.zh: 念茲名節，感嘆良深，宜洽恩榮，俾弘激勸。

translations.literal: Considering this reputation and integrity, deeply moved with admiration—favor and glory should be extended to broaden encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Considering this reputation and integrity, deeply moved with admiration—favor and glory should be extended to broaden encouragement.

sentences.zh: 禮無避於金革，理當由於權奪，戎章憲府，式示兼崇。

translations.literal: Rites do not avoid metal and leather; principle should follow expedient seizure of mourning—military insignia and censorate office together show combined honor.
translations.idiomatic: Rites do not avoid metal and leather; principle should follow expedient seizure of mourning—military insignia and censorate office together show combined honor.

sentences.zh: 可起復雲麾將軍，守金吾衛大將軍、員外置同正員，檢校太子詹事、兼御史中丞，仍委淮南節度使與要職事任使。」

translations.literal: He may rise from mourning as general of the Cloud Banner Guard, hold the post of general of the Golden Guard, supernumerary equal to regular, acting mentor of the Heir Apparent and concurrently surveillance censor, and still be entrusted by the Huainan military commissioner with important duties as he sees fit."
translations.idiomatic: He may rise from mourning as general of the Cloud Banner Guard, hold the post of general of the Golden Guard, supernumerary equal to regular, acting mentor of the Heir Apparent and concurrently surveillance censor, and still be entrusted by the Huainan military commissioner with important duties as he sees fit."

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「張重政母高平郡夫人徐氏，族茂姻閥，行表柔明，懷正家之美，有擇鄰之識。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "Zhang Chongzheng's mother, Lady of Gaoping Commandery Xu—clan flourishing in marriage alliances, conduct showing gentle clarity, cherishing the beauty of rectifying the household, with wisdom to choose neighbors.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "Zhang Chongzheng's mother, Lady of Gaoping Commandery Xu—clan flourishing in marriage alliances, conduct showing gentle clarity, cherishing the beauty of rectifying the household, with wisdom to choose neighbors.

sentences.zh: 頃當變故，曾不詭隨，保其門宗，訓成忠孝，雖圖史所載，何以加之！

translations.literal: Facing recent change she never wavered in crooked compliance, preserved her house and lineage, trained loyalty and filial piety—though recorded in histories and annals, what could add to this!
translations.idiomatic: Facing recent change she never wavered in crooked compliance, preserved her house and lineage, trained loyalty and filial piety—though recorded in histories and annals, what could add to this!

sentences.zh: 念其令子，已申獎用，特彰母儀之德，俾崇封國之榮。

translations.literal: Considering her worthy son, already rewarded in appointment—specially displaying maternal virtue, granting ennoblement of the state's honor.
translations.idiomatic: Considering her worthy son, already rewarded in appointment—specially displaying maternal virtue, granting ennoblement of the state's honor.

sentences.zh: 可封魯國太夫人。」

translations.literal: She may be enfeoffed as Grand Lady of Lu."
translations.idiomatic: She may be enfeoffed as Grand Lady of Lu."

sentences.zh: 甄濟

translations.literal: Zhen Ji
translations.idiomatic: Zhen Ji

sentences.zh: 甄濟，字孟成，中山無極人，家於衛州。

translations.literal: Zhen Ji, styled Mengcheng, was a native of Wuji in Zhongshan, residing in Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen Ji, styled Mengcheng, was a native of Wuji in Zhongshan, residing in Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 少孤，天寶中隱居衛州青巖山。

translations.literal: Orphaned young, in the Tianbao era he lived in seclusion on Mount Qingyan in Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young, in the Tianbao era he lived in seclusion on Mount Qingyan in Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 人伏其操行，約不畋漁。

translations.literal: People admired his conduct; he pledged not to hunt or fish.
translations.idiomatic: People admired his conduct; he pledged not to hunt or fish.

sentences.zh: 采訪使安祿山表薦之，授試大理評事，充范陽郡節度掌記。

translations.literal: Investigation Commissioner An Lushan memorialized recommending him, appointing him acting reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review and secretary of the Fanyang Commandery military commission.
translations.idiomatic: Investigation Commissioner An Lushan memorialized recommending him, appointing him acting reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review and secretary of the Fanyang Commandery military commission.

sentences.zh: 天寶末，安祿山有異志，謀以智免。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianbao An Lushan had rebellious intent; Ji planned to escape by wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Tianbao An Lushan had rebellious intent; Ji planned to escape by wisdom.

sentences.zh: 衛縣令齊玘誠信可託，乃求使至衛，具以誠告。

translations.literal: Wei County Magistrate Qi Chi was trustworthy; he sought assignment to Wei and fully told him in sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Wei County Magistrate Qi Chi was trustworthy; he sought assignment to Wei and fully told him in sincerity.

sentences.zh: 弟憕密求羊血以為備，至夜，偽嘔血疾不能支，遂舁歸。

translations.literal: His younger brother Cheng secretly obtained sheep's blood as preparation; at night he feigned vomiting blood, illness unbearable, and was carried home.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Cheng secretly obtained sheep's blood as preparation; at night he feigned vomiting blood, illness unbearable, and was carried home.

sentences.zh: 及祿山反，使偽節度使蔡希德領行戮者李掞等二人，封刀來召，察濟詐不起，即就戮之。

translations.literal: When Lushan rebelled he sent the false military commissioner Cai Xide leading executioner Li Shan and another man, sealing a blade to summon him; seeing Ji's pretense of inability to rise, they immediately executed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Lushan rebelled he sent the false military commissioner Cai Xide leading executioner Li Shan and another man, sealing a blade to summon him; seeing Ji's pretense of inability to rise, they immediately executed him.

sentences.zh: 濟以左手書云：「去不得！」

translations.literal: Ji wrote with his left hand: "Cannot go!"
translations.idiomatic: Ji wrote with his left hand: "Cannot go!"

sentences.zh: 李掞持刀而前，濟引首以待，希德歔欷嗟嘆之，曰：「李掞退。」

translations.literal: Li Shan advanced with blade; Ji offered his neck and waited; Xide sighed and lamented and said, "Li Shan, withdraw."
translations.idiomatic: Li Shan advanced with blade; Ji offered his neck and waited; Xide sighed and lamented and said, "Li Shan, withdraw."

sentences.zh: 以實病報祿山。

translations.literal: He reported genuine illness to Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: He reported genuine illness to Lushan.

sentences.zh: 後安慶緒亦使人至縣，強舁至東都安國觀。

translations.literal: Later An Qingxu also sent men to the county, forcibly carrying him to Anguo Temple in the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Later An Qingxu also sent men to the county, forcibly carrying him to Anguo Temple in the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 經月餘，代宗收東京。

translations.literal: After more than a month Emperor Daizong recovered the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month Emperor Daizong recovered the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 濟起，詣軍門上謁，乃送上都。

translations.literal: Ji rose, went to the army gate to present himself, and was sent up to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ji rose, went to the army gate to present himself, and was sent up to the capital.

sentences.zh: 肅宗館之於三司使，令受偽命官瞻望，以愧其心。

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong lodged him at the Three Offices commissioner, ordering those who had accepted false appointments to look upon him and shame their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong lodged him at the Three Offices commissioner, ordering those who had accepted false appointments to look upon him and shame their hearts.

sentences.zh: 授秘書郎，轉太子舍人。

translations.literal: He was appointed secretary; transferred to secretary to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed secretary; transferred to secretary to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 寶應初，拜刑部員外郎。

translations.literal: In the early Baoying era he was appointed vice director in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Baoying era he was appointed vice director in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 魏少遊奏授著作郎、兼侍御史，終於襄州。

translations.literal: Wei Shaoyou memorialized appointing him compiler and concurrently attendant censor; he died at Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shaoyou memorialized appointing him compiler and concurrently attendant censor; he died at Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 元和中，襄州節度使袁滋奏其節行，詔曰：「符風樹節，謂之立名；

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe era Xiangzhou Military Commissioner Yuan Zi memorialized his integrity; an edict said: "Upholding wind and establishing integrity is called making a name;
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanhe era Xiangzhou Military Commissioner Yuan Zi memorialized his integrity; an edict said: "Upholding wind and establishing integrity is called making a name;

sentences.zh: 歿加褒贈，所以誘善。

translations.literal: after death adding enfeoffment is to entice goodness.
translations.idiomatic: after death adding enfeoffment is to entice goodness.

sentences.zh: 故朝散大夫、秘書省著作郎、兼侍御史甄濟，早以文雅，見稱於時。

translations.literal: The late Court Gentleman for Miscellaneous Uses, Compiler of the Secretariat and concurrently Attendant Censor Zhen Ji, early for literary elegance was praised in his time.
translations.idiomatic: The late Court Gentleman for Miscellaneous Uses, Compiler of the Secretariat and concurrently Attendant Censor Zhen Ji, early for literary elegance was praised in his time.

sentences.zh: 嘗因辟召，亦佐戎府。

translations.literal: Having once accepted recruitment he also assisted a military staff;
translations.idiomatic: Having once accepted recruitment he also assisted a military staff;

sentences.zh: 而能保堅貞之正性，不履危機；

translations.literal: yet he could preserve steadfast upright nature and not tread perilous opportunity;
translations.idiomatic: yet he could preserve steadfast upright nature and not tread perilous opportunity;

sentences.zh: 睹逆亂之潛萌，不從脅汙。

translations.literal: seeing rebellion's hidden sprouting he did not follow coercion and defilement.
translations.idiomatic: seeing rebellion's hidden sprouting he did not follow coercion and defilement.

sentences.zh: 義聲可傳於竹帛，顯贈未賁於松楸。

translations.literal: Righteous fame can be transmitted on bamboo and silk; illustrious posthumous reward was not yet bestowed on pine and oak.
translations.idiomatic: Righteous fame can be transmitted on bamboo and silk; illustrious posthumous reward was not yet bestowed on pine and oak.

sentences.zh: 籓方所陳，允葉彜典，追加命秩，以獎忠魂。

translations.literal: What the frontier memorialized accords with canonical law; additional rank is granted to reward the loyal soul.
translations.idiomatic: What the frontier memorialized accords with canonical law; additional rank is granted to reward the loyal soul.

sentences.zh: 可贈秘書少監。」

translations.literal: He may be posthumously enfeoffed as vice director of the Secretariat."
translations.idiomatic: He may be posthumously enfeoffed as vice director of the Secretariat."

sentences.zh: 劉敦儒

translations.literal: Liu Dunru
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dunru

sentences.zh: 劉敦儒，開元朝史官左散騎常侍子玄之孫。

translations.literal: Liu Dunru was grandson of Zixuan, Left Regular Attendant and historiographer of the Kaiyuan court.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dunru was grandson of Zixuan, Left Regular Attendant and historiographer of the Kaiyuan court.

sentences.zh: 敦儒母有心疾，非日鞭人不安，子弟僕使，不勝其苦，皆逃遁他處，唯敦儒侍養不息，體常流血。

translations.literal: Dunru's mother had a heart ailment and was uneasy unless she whipped people daily; sons, servants, and attendants could not bear the suffering and all fled elsewhere—only Dunru attended without cease, his body often bleeding.
translations.idiomatic: Dunru's mother had a heart ailment and was uneasy unless she whipped people daily; sons, servants, and attendants could not bear the suffering and all fled elsewhere—only Dunru attended without cease, his body often bleeding.

sentences.zh: 及母亡，居喪毀瘠骨立，洛中謂之劉孝子。

translations.literal: When his mother died he dwelt in mourning, wasted to bones standing; Luoyang called him Filial Son Liu.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he dwelt in mourning, wasted to bones standing; Luoyang called him Filial Son Liu.

sentences.zh: 元和中，東都留守權德輿具奏其至行，詔曰：「孝子劉敦儒，生於儒門，稟此至性。

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe era Eastern Capital Resident Guardian Quan Deyu fully memorialized his utmost conduct; an edict said: "Filial son Liu Dunru, born in a Confucian house, endowed with this utmost nature.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanhe era Eastern Capital Resident Guardian Quan Deyu fully memorialized his utmost conduct; an edict said: "Filial son Liu Dunru, born in a Confucian house, endowed with this utmost nature.

sentences.zh: 王祥篤行，起孝敬而不移；

translations.literal: Wang Xiang's earnest conduct, arising in filial respect and not shifting;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiang's earnest conduct, arising in filial respect and not shifting;

sentences.zh: 曾參養志，積歲年而罔怠。

translations.literal: Zeng Shen nourishing his father's will, accumulating years without slackening.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Shen nourishing his father's will, accumulating years without slackening.

sentences.zh: 用弘勸獎，而服官常，分曹洛師，俾遂私志。

translations.literal: To extend encouragement and reward while holding regular office, assigned to Luoyang in a scattered bureau, allowing private wish to be fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: To extend encouragement and reward while holding regular office, assigned to Luoyang in a scattered bureau, allowing private wish to be fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 可左龍武軍兵曹參軍，分司東都。」

translations.literal: He may be Left Dragon Martial Army military affairs adjutant, assigned to Eastern Capital."
translations.idiomatic: He may be Left Dragon Martial Army military affairs adjutant, assigned to Eastern Capital."

sentences.zh: 高沐

translations.literal: Gao Mu
translations.idiomatic: Gao Mu

sentences.zh: 高沐，渤海人。

translations.literal: Gao Mu was a man of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Mu was a man of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 父憑，從事於宣武軍，知曹州事。

translations.literal: His father Ping served on the staff of the Xuanwu army and managed affairs of Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ping served on the staff of the Xuanwu army and managed affairs of Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 李靈曜作亂，憑密遣使奏賊中事狀，詔除曹州刺史。

translations.literal: When Li Lingyao rebelled, Ping secretly sent envoys to memorialize conditions in the rebel camp; an edict appointed him prefect of Cao.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Lingyao rebelled, Ping secretly sent envoys to memorialize conditions in the rebel camp; an edict appointed him prefect of Cao.

sentences.zh: 無何，李正己盜有曹、濮，憑遂陷於賊，數年卒。

translations.literal: Before long Li Zhengyi seized Cao and Pu; Ping then fell to the rebels and died after several years.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Li Zhengyi seized Cao and Pu; Ping then fell to the rebels and died after several years.

sentences.zh: 沐，貞元中進士及第。

translations.literal: Mu passed the jinshi in the Zhenyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: Mu passed the jinshi in the Zhenyuan era.

sentences.zh: 以家族在鄆，李師古置為判官。

translations.literal: Because his clan was at Yan, Li Shigu appointed him case officer.
translations.idiomatic: Because his clan was at Yan, Li Shigu appointed him case officer.

sentences.zh: 居數年，師道擅襲，每謀不順，沐與同列郭昈、李公度等，必廣引古今成敗諭之，前後說師道為善者凡千言。

translations.literal: After several years Shidao usurped succession; whenever he plotted disobedience, Mu with colleagues Guo Guang and Li Gongdu and others would widely cite success and failure from past and present to instruct him—for goodness they admonished Shidao in all more than a thousand words.
translations.idiomatic: After several years Shidao usurped succession; whenever he plotted disobedience, Mu with colleagues Guo Guang and Li Gongdu and others would widely cite success and failure from past and present to instruct him—for goodness they admonished Shidao in all more than a thousand words.

sentences.zh: 其判官李文會、孔目官林英，皆為師道信用，乘間相與涕泣於師道前曰：「文會等血誠憂尚書家事，反為高沐輩所嫉。

translations.literal: His case officers Li Wenhui and clerical officer Lin Ying were all trusted by Shidao; seizing the moment they together wept before Shidao and said, "Wenhui and the others in bloody sincerity worry over the minister's household affairs, yet are envied by Gao Mu and his ilk.
translations.idiomatic: His case officers Li Wenhui and clerical officer Lin Ying were all trusted by Shidao; seizing the moment they together wept before Shidao and said, "Wenhui and the others in bloody sincerity worry over the minister's household affairs, yet are envied by Gao Mu and his ilk.

sentences.zh: 尚書奈何不惜十二州之城，成高沐等百代之名乎！」

translations.literal: Minister, how can you not spare the twelve prefectures' cities to complete Gao Mu and others' fame for a hundred generations!"
translations.idiomatic: Minister, how can you not spare the twelve prefectures' cities to complete Gao Mu and others' fame for a hundred generations!"

sentences.zh: 復日夜讒構，由是漸見疑忌，令沐知萊州事。

translations.literal: Again day and night they slandered and framed; thereby he was gradually suspected and ordered to manage Laizhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Again day and night they slandered and framed; thereby he was gradually suspected and ordered to manage Laizhou affairs.

sentences.zh: 林英因奏事至京，逼邸吏密報師道云：「高沐潛有誠款至朝廷矣！」

translations.literal: Lin Ying because of reporting affairs reached the capital and forced relay-station clerks to secretly report to Shidao, "Gao Mu secretly has sincere loyalty reaching the court!"
translations.idiomatic: Lin Ying because of reporting affairs reached the capital and forced relay-station clerks to secretly report to Shidao, "Gao Mu secretly has sincere loyalty reaching the court!"

sentences.zh: 師道大怒，李文會從而構成之。

translations.literal: Shidao was greatly enraged; Li Wenhui followed by framing the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao was greatly enraged; Li Wenhui followed by framing the matter.

sentences.zh: 沐遂遇害於遷所，而囚郭昈於萊州，其血屬皆徙遠地。

translations.literal: Mu then suffered harm at his place of transfer; Guo Guang was imprisoned at Laizhou and all blood kin were exiled to distant lands.
translations.idiomatic: Mu then suffered harm at his place of transfer; Guo Guang was imprisoned at Laizhou and all blood kin were exiled to distant lands.

sentences.zh: 及淮西平，師道漸懼。

translations.literal: When Huaixi was pacified Shidao gradually feared.
translations.idiomatic: When Huaixi was pacified Shidao gradually feared.

sentences.zh: 李公度與其將李英曇乘其懼也，說師道獻三州及入質長子。

translations.literal: Li Gongdu and his general Li Yingtan seized his fear and persuaded Shidao to offer three prefectures and send his eldest son as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gongdu and his general Li Yingtan seized his fear and persuaded Shidao to offer three prefectures and send his eldest son as hostage.

sentences.zh: 初，甚然之，中悔，將殺公度。

translations.literal: At first he greatly agreed; midway he regretted and was about to kill Gongdu.
translations.idiomatic: At first he greatly agreed; midway he regretted and was about to kill Gongdu.

sentences.zh: 賈直言聞之，謂師道用事奴曰：「今大禍將至，豈非高沐冤氣所為！

translations.literal: Jia Zhiyan heard and told Shidao's powerful slave, "Great disaster is about to arrive—is it not done by Gao Mu's wronged spirit!
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhiyan heard and told Shidao's powerful slave, "Great disaster is about to arrive—is it not done by Gao Mu's wronged spirit!

sentences.zh: 又殺公度，是益其疾也！」

translations.literal: To kill Gongdu again only worsens the illness!"
translations.idiomatic: To kill Gongdu again only worsens the illness!"

sentences.zh: 乃止。

translations.literal: He then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He then stopped.

sentences.zh: 逐英曇於萊州。

translations.literal: Yingtan was exiled to Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yingtan was exiled to Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 未至，縊殺之。

translations.literal: Before arriving he was strangled to death.
translations.idiomatic: Before arriving he was strangled to death.

sentences.zh: 又有崔承寵、楊偕、陳佑、崔清，皆以仗順為賊所惡，李文會呼為高沐之黨。

translations.literal: There were also Cui Chengzong, Yang Xie, Chen You, and Cui Qing—all because they upheld obedience were hated by rebels; Li Wenhui called them Gao Mu's faction.
translations.idiomatic: There were also Cui Chengzong, Yang Xie, Chen You, and Cui Qing—all because they upheld obedience were hated by rebels; Li Wenhui called them Gao Mu's faction.

sentences.zh: 沐遇害，承寵等同被囚放。

translations.literal: When Mu suffered harm, Chengzong and the others were likewise imprisoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: When Mu suffered harm, Chengzong and the others were likewise imprisoned and released.

sentences.zh: 郭昈名亞於沐，雖不死，備嘗困辱矣。

translations.literal: Guo Guang's fame was second to Mu's; though he did not die he fully tasted hardship and humiliation.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Guang's fame was second to Mu's; though he did not die he fully tasted hardship and humiliation.

sentences.zh: 及劉悟平賊，遽召李公度，執手歔欷。

translations.literal: When Liu Wu pacified the rebels he swiftly summoned Li Gongdu and grasped his hand, sighing.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Wu pacified the rebels he swiftly summoned Li Gongdu and grasped his hand, sighing.

sentences.zh: 既除滑州節度，首辟昈及公度為從事。

translations.literal: Once appointed Huazhou military commissioner he first recruited Guang and Gongdu as staff members.
translations.idiomatic: Once appointed Huazhou military commissioner he first recruited Guang and Gongdu as staff members.

sentences.zh: 元和十四年四月，詔曰：

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year of Yuanhe an edict said:
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year of Yuanhe an edict said:

sentences.zh: 圖難忘死，為臣之峻節；

translations.literal: Facing difficulty and forgetting death is a minister's stern integrity;
translations.idiomatic: Facing difficulty and forgetting death is a minister's stern integrity;

sentences.zh: 顯忠旌善，有國之令猷。

translations.literal: displaying loyalty and signaling goodness is a state's fine plan.
translations.idiomatic: displaying loyalty and signaling goodness is a state's fine plan.

sentences.zh: 日者妖豎反覆，侮我朝章，而濮州刺史高沐，劫在兇威，潛輸忠款。

translations.literal: Recently the wicked villain reversed and repeated, insulting our court statutes; yet Puzhou Prefect Gao Mu, seized in villainous might, secretly conveyed loyal sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the wicked villain reversed and repeated, insulting our court statutes; yet Puzhou Prefect Gao Mu, seized in villainous might, secretly conveyed loyal sincerity.

sentences.zh: 諷其不庭之咎，將冀革心；

translations.literal: Admonishing his fault of insubordination, he hoped to reform the heart;
translations.idiomatic: Admonishing his fault of insubordination, he hoped to reform the heart;

sentences.zh: 數其煮海之饒，聿求利國。

translations.literal: counting the riches of boiling sea, he sought benefit for the state.
translations.idiomatic: counting the riches of boiling sea, he sought benefit for the state.

sentences.zh: 伏奏必陳於逆節，漏師常破其陰謀。

translations.literal: Secret memorials always stated rebellious conduct; leaking plans he often broke hidden conspiracies.
translations.idiomatic: Secret memorials always stated rebellious conduct; leaking plans he often broke hidden conspiracies.

sentences.zh: 竟以盜憎，遂死王事，歿而不朽，風聲凜然。

translations.literal: Ultimately because robbers hated him he died in royal service—perished yet not decayed, reputation stern and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Ultimately because robbers hated him he died in royal service—perished yet not decayed, reputation stern and clear.

sentences.zh: 式表漏泉之澤，且彰勁草之節。

translations.literal: Thus showing the favor of the leaking spring and displaying the integrity of firm grass.
translations.idiomatic: Thus showing the favor of the leaking spring and displaying the integrity of firm grass.

sentences.zh: 可贈吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He may be posthumously enfeoffed as minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He may be posthumously enfeoffed as minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 仍委馬總訪其遺骸，以禮收葬，優恤其家。

translations.literal: Still entrust Ma Zong to seek his remains, bury them with rites, and generously comfort his family.
translations.idiomatic: Still entrust Ma Zong to seek his remains, bury them with rites, and generously comfort his family.

sentences.zh: 若有子孫，具名聞奏。

translations.literal: If there are descendants, report their names in full.
translations.idiomatic: If there are descendants, report their names in full.

sentences.zh: 賈直言

translations.literal: Jia Zhiyan
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhiyan

sentences.zh: 賈直言者，父道沖，以伎術得罪，貶之，賜鴆於路。

translations.literal: Jia Zhiyan—his father Daochong, because of skill in arts offended, was demoted and given poison on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhiyan—his father Daochong, because of skill in arts offended, was demoted and given poison on the road.

sentences.zh: 直言偽令其父拜四方，辭上下神祗，伺使者視稍怠，即取其鴆以飲，遂迷仆而死。

translations.literal: Zhiyan falsely ordered his father to bow to the four directions, bidding farewell to spirits above and below; when the envoy's gaze slackened slightly he took the poison and drank it, then fell insensible as if dead.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyan falsely ordered his father to bow to the four directions, bidding farewell to spirits above and below; when the envoy's gaze slackened slightly he took the poison and drank it, then fell insensible as if dead.

sentences.zh: 明日鴆泄於足而復蘇。

translations.literal: The next day the poison passed from his feet and he revived.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the poison passed from his feet and he revived.

sentences.zh: 代宗聞之，減父死，直言亦自此病蹙。

translations.literal: Emperor Daizong heard and reduced his father's death; from this Zhiyan also had a limping illness.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daizong heard and reduced his father's death; from this Zhiyan also had a limping illness.

sentences.zh: 後從事於李師道。

translations.literal: Later he served on Li Shidao's staff.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served on Li Shidao's staff.

sentences.zh: 師道不恭朝命，直言冒刃說者二，輿櫬說者一。

translations.literal: Shidao was disrespectful of court orders; Zhiyan braved blades to admonish twice and once admonished bearing his coffin.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao was disrespectful of court orders; Zhiyan braved blades to admonish twice and once admonished bearing his coffin.

sentences.zh: 師道訖不從。

translations.literal: Shidao to the end did not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao to the end did not follow.

sentences.zh: 及劉悟斬師道，節制鄭滑，得直言於禁錮之間，又嘉其所為，因奏置幕中。

translations.literal: When Liu Wu beheaded Shidao and governed Zheng and Hua he obtained Zhiyan from imprisonment and also praised his conduct, memorializing to place him on staff.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Wu beheaded Shidao and governed Zheng and Hua he obtained Zhiyan from imprisonment and also praised his conduct, memorializing to place him on staff.

sentences.zh: 後遷於潞，亦與之俱行。

translations.literal: Later transferred to Lu, he went together with him.
translations.idiomatic: Later transferred to Lu, he went together with him.

sentences.zh: 悟纖微乖失，直言必盡理箴規，以是美譽日聞於朝。

translations.literal: Whenever Wu had the slightest fault Zhiyan always fully reasoned and admonished; thereby good reputation daily reached court.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Wu had the slightest fault Zhiyan always fully reasoned and admonished; thereby good reputation daily reached court.

sentences.zh: 穆宗以諫議大夫征之，悟拜章乞留，復授檢校右庶子、兼御史大夫，依前充昭義軍行軍司馬。

translations.literal: Emperor Muzong summoned him as remonstrance official; Wu submitted a memorial begging to retain him, again appointing him acting right vice mentor and concurrently censor-in-chief, continuing as Zhaoyi army acting marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Muzong summoned him as remonstrance official; Wu submitted a memorial begging to retain him, again appointing him acting right vice mentor and concurrently censor-in-chief, continuing as Zhaoyi army acting marshal.

sentences.zh: 悟用其言，終身不虧臣節。

translations.literal: Wu used his words and to the end did not fail ministerial integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Wu used his words and to the end did not fail ministerial integrity.

sentences.zh: 後歷太子賓客。

translations.literal: Later he served as mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served as mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 太和九年三月卒，廢朝一日，贈工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year of Taihe he died; court was suspended one day and he was posthumously enfeoffed as minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year of Taihe he died; court was suspended one day and he was posthumously enfeoffed as minister of works.

sentences.zh: 庾敬休

translations.literal: Yu Jingxiu
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jingxiu

sentences.zh: 庾敬休，字順之，其先南陽新野人。

translations.literal: Yu Jingxiu, styled Shunzhi, was originally a native of Xinye in Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jingxiu, styled Shunzhi, was originally a native of Xinye in Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 祖光烈，與仲弟光先，祿山迫以偽官，皆潛伏奔竄。

translations.literal: His grandfather Guanglie, with his second younger brother Guangxian, when Lushan forced them into false office both hid and fled.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Guanglie, with his second younger brother Guangxian, when Lushan forced them into false office both hid and fled.

sentences.zh: 光烈為大理少卿，光先為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Guanglie was vice director of the Court of Judicial Review; Guangxian was vice director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Guanglie was vice director of the Court of Judicial Review; Guangxian was vice director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 父河，當賊泚盜據宮闕，與季弟倬逃竄山谷。

translations.literal: His father He, when rebel Zhu Ci seized the palace, fled with his youngest younger brother Zhuo to mountain valleys.
translations.idiomatic: His father He, when rebel Zhu Ci seized the palace, fled with his youngest younger brother Zhuo to mountain valleys.

sentences.zh: 河終兵部郎中。

translations.literal: He finally served as director in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He finally served as director in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 敬休舉進士，以宏詞登科，授秘書省校書郎，從事宣州。

translations.literal: Jingxiu passed the jinshi and entered by macro-phrase examination, appointed proofreader of the Secretariat, serving Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxiu passed the jinshi and entered by macro-phrase examination, appointed proofreader of the Secretariat, serving Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 旋授渭南尉、集賢校理。

translations.literal: Soon appointed vice magistrate of Weinan and collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Soon appointed vice magistrate of Weinan and collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 遷右拾遺、集賢學士。

translations.literal: Transferred to Right Remonstrance Official and academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Right Remonstrance Official and academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 歷右補闕，稱職，轉起居舍人，俄遷禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: He served in succession as Right Remonstrance Official, performed duties well, transferred to recorder of conduct, soon transferred to vice director in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as Right Remonstrance Official, performed duties well, transferred to recorder of conduct, soon transferred to vice director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 入為翰林學士，遷禮部郎中，罷職歸官。

translations.literal: He entered as Hanlin academician, transferred to director in the Ministry of Rites, left office and returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: He entered as Hanlin academician, transferred to director in the Ministry of Rites, left office and returned to his post.

sentences.zh: 又遷兵部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: Again transferred to director in the Ministry of War and drafter of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Again transferred to director in the Ministry of War and drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 丁憂，服闋，改工部侍郎，權知吏部選事，遷吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: When mourning ended after his father's death and service was complete, he was changed to vice director of the Ministry of Works, acting director of personnel selection, transferred to vice director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended after his father's death and service was complete, he was changed to vice director of the Ministry of Works, acting director of personnel selection, transferred to vice director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 上將立魯王為太子，慎選師傅，改工部侍郎，兼魯王傅。

translations.literal: The emperor was about to establish the Prince of Lu as Heir Apparent; tutors were carefully chosen and he was changed to vice director of the Ministry of Works and concurrently tutor to the Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was about to establish the Prince of Lu as Heir Apparent; tutors were carefully chosen and he was changed to vice director of the Ministry of Works and concurrently tutor to the Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 奏：「劍南西川、山南西道每年稅茶及除陌錢，舊例委度支巡院勾當，榷稅當司於上都召商人便換。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Jiannan West Circuit and Shannan West Circuit each year tax tea and removal-money; by old precedent the disbursement commissioner's touring office handled it, and the monopoly tax office at the capital summoned merchants for convenient exchange.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Jiannan West Circuit and Shannan West Circuit each year tax tea and removal-money; by old precedent the disbursement commissioner's touring office handled it, and the monopoly tax office at the capital summoned merchants for convenient exchange.

sentences.zh: 太和元年，戶部侍郎崔元略與西川節度使商量，取其穩便，遂奏請茶稅事使司自勾當，每年出錢四萬貫送省。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taihe Vice Minister of Revenue Cui Yuanlue with the West Circuit military commissioner discussed and took what was stable, then memorialized that tea tax affairs should be handled by the circuit office itself, each year sending forty thousand strings to the central government.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taihe Vice Minister of Revenue Cui Yuanlue with the West Circuit military commissioner discussed and took what was stable, then memorialized that tea tax affairs should be handled by the circuit office itself, each year sending forty thousand strings to the central government.

sentences.zh: 近年已來，不依元奏，三道諸色錢物，州府逗留，多不送省。

translations.literal: In recent years they have not followed the original memorial; the three circuits' various monies and goods have been detained by prefectures and not sent to the center.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years they have not followed the original memorial; the three circuits' various monies and goods have been detained by prefectures and not sent to the center.

sentences.zh: 請取江西例，於歸州置巡院一所，自勾當收管諸色錢物送省，所冀免有逋懸。

translations.literal: I request following the Jiangxi precedent, establishing one touring office at Guizhou to handle and collect all monies and goods and send them to the center, hoping to avoid arrears.
translations.idiomatic: I request following the Jiangxi precedent, establishing one touring office at Guizhou to handle and collect all monies and goods and send them to the center, hoping to avoid arrears.

sentences.zh: 欲令巡官李濆專往與德裕、遵古商量制置，續具奏聞。」

translations.literal: I wish to send touring official Li Fen specially to discuss arrangements with Deyu and Zungu and then report fully in a memorial."
translations.idiomatic: I wish to send touring official Li Fen specially to discuss arrangements with Deyu and Zungu and then report fully in a memorial."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「兩川米價騰踴，百姓流亡。

translations.literal: He again memorialized: "In the two circuits rice prices soar and common people flee.
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized: "In the two circuits rice prices soar and common people flee.

sentences.zh: 請糶兩川闕官職田祿米，以救貧人。」

translations.literal: I request selling vacant official salary-field rice of the two circuits to aid the poor."
translations.idiomatic: I request selling vacant official salary-field rice of the two circuits to aid the poor."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 再為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: He again became Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He again became Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太和九年三月，卒於家。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year of Taihe he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year of Taihe he died at home.

sentences.zh: 敬休姿容溫雅，襟抱夷曠，不飲酒茹葷，不邇聲色。

translations.literal: Jingxiu's bearing was warm and elegant, his mind broad and untroubled; he did not drink wine, eat meat, or approach music and women.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxiu's bearing was warm and elegant, his mind broad and untroubled; he did not drink wine, eat meat, or approach music and women.

sentences.zh: 著《諭善錄》七卷。

translations.literal: He authored Exhortations to Goodness in seven scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: He authored Exhortations to Goodness in seven scrolls.

sentences.zh: 贈吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 辛讜

translations.literal: Xin Tan
translations.idiomatic: Xin Tan

sentences.zh: 辛讜，故太原尹雲京之孫，壽州刺史晦之猶子也。

translations.literal: Xin Tan was grandson of Yunjing, former metropolitan magistrate of Taiyuan, and nephew of Hui, prefect of Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Tan was grandson of Yunjing, former metropolitan magistrate of Taiyuan, and nephew of Hui, prefect of Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 性慷慨，重然諾，專務賑人之急。

translations.literal: By nature generous, he valued promises and specially devoted himself to relieving others' emergencies.
translations.idiomatic: By nature generous, he valued promises and specially devoted himself to relieving others' emergencies.

sentences.zh: 年五十，不求茍進，有濟時匡難之志。

translations.literal: At fifty he did not seek advancement by compromise; he had the will to aid the age and rescue difficulty.
translations.idiomatic: At fifty he did not seek advancement by compromise; he had the will to aid the age and rescue difficulty.

sentences.zh: 咸通十年，龐勛亂徐泗。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xiantong Pang Xun rebelled in Xu and Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xiantong Pang Xun rebelled in Xu and Si.

sentences.zh: 時杜慆守泗州，賊以郡當江淮要害，極力攻之。

translations.literal: At that time Du Tao defended Sizhou; the rebels because the prefecture lay at the key point of the Jiang and Huai exerted extreme force attacking it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Du Tao defended Sizhou; the rebels because the prefecture lay at the key point of the Jiang and Huai exerted extreme force attacking it.

sentences.zh: 時兩淮郡縣皆陷。

translations.literal: At that time the two Huai prefectures all fell.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the two Huai prefectures all fell.

sentences.zh: 慆守臨淮久之，援軍雖集，賊未解圍。

translations.literal: Tao held Linhuai for a long time; though relief armies gathered the rebels did not lift the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Tao held Linhuai for a long time; though relief armies gathered the rebels did not lift the siege.

sentences.zh: 時讜寓居廣陵，乃仗劍拏小艇趨泗口，貫城柵入城見慆。

translations.literal: At that time Tan was lodging at Guangling; he then grasped sword, took a small boat, and hurried to Sizhou, piercing the city palisade to enter the city and see Tao.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Tan was lodging at Guangling; he then grasped sword, took a small boat, and hurried to Sizhou, piercing the city palisade to enter the city and see Tao.

sentences.zh: 慆素聞有義而不相面，喜讜至，握手謝曰：「判官李延樞方話子為人，何遽至耶？

translations.literal: Tao had long heard of his righteousness but had never met him face to face; delighted at Tan's arrival he grasped his hand and thanked him: "Case officer Li Yanshu was just speaking of you—how did you come so swiftly?
translations.idiomatic: Tao had long heard of his righteousness but had never met him face to face; delighted at Tan's arrival he grasped his hand and thanked him: "Case officer Li Yanshu was just speaking of you—how did you come so swiftly?

sentences.zh: 吾無憂矣！」

translations.literal: I have no worry!"
translations.idiomatic: I have no worry!"

sentences.zh: 時賊三面攻城，王師結壘於洪源驛。

translations.literal: At that time rebels attacked the city on three sides; imperial armies encamped at Hongyuan Station.
translations.idiomatic: At that time rebels attacked the city on three sides; imperial armies encamped at Hongyuan Station.

sentences.zh: 相顧不前。

translations.literal: They looked at each other and did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: They looked at each other and did not advance.

sentences.zh: 讜夜以小舟穿賊壘至洪源驛。

translations.literal: Tan at night took a small boat through the rebel camp to Hongyuan Station.
translations.idiomatic: Tan at night took a small boat through the rebel camp to Hongyuan Station.

sentences.zh: 見監軍郭厚本，論泗州危急，且宜速救，厚本然之。

translations.literal: He saw Military Supervisor Guo Houben, discussed Sizhou's extreme peril, and that relief should be swift; Houben agreed.
translations.idiomatic: He saw Military Supervisor Guo Houben, discussed Sizhou's extreme peril, and that relief should be swift; Houben agreed.

sentences.zh: 淮南都將王公弁謂厚本曰：「賊眾我寡，無宜輕舉，當俟可行。」

translations.literal: Huainan general Wang Gongbian told Houben, "Rebel forces are many, ours few—no light move should be made; we should wait until action is feasible."
translations.idiomatic: Huainan general Wang Gongbian told Houben, "Rebel forces are many, ours few—no light move should be made; we should wait until action is feasible."

sentences.zh: 讜坐中拔劍瞋目謂公弁曰：「賊百道攻城，陷在旦夕。

translations.literal: Tan in the gathering drew sword, glared, and told Gongbian, "The rebels attack the city on a hundred paths; capture is imminent.
translations.idiomatic: Tan in the gathering drew sword, glared, and told Gongbian, "The rebels attack the city on a hundred paths; capture is imminent.

sentences.zh: 公等奉詔赴援，而逗留不進，更欲何為？

translations.literal: You all received orders to aid—yet linger without advancing; what more do you intend?
translations.idiomatic: You all received orders to aid—yet linger without advancing; what more do you intend?

sentences.zh: 不唯有負國恩，丈夫氣義，亦宜感發！

translations.literal: Not only do you fail national grace—a man's righteous spirit should also be stirred!
translations.idiomatic: Not only do you fail national grace—a man's righteous spirit should also be stirred!

sentences.zh: 假如臨淮陷賊，淮南即是寇場，公何獨存耶！」

translations.literal: If Linhuai falls to rebels, Huainan becomes the bandits' battlefield—why do you alone preserve yourself!"
translations.idiomatic: If Linhuai falls to rebels, Huainan becomes the bandits' battlefield—why do you alone preserve yourself!"

sentences.zh: 即欲揮刃向公弁，厚本持之。

translations.literal: He was about to swing the blade at Gongbian; Houben restrained him.
translations.idiomatic: He was about to swing the blade at Gongbian; Houben restrained him.

sentences.zh: 讜望泗州大哭經日，帳下為之流涕。

translations.literal: Tan faced Sizhou and wept all day; those in the tent wept for him.
translations.idiomatic: Tan faced Sizhou and wept all day; those in the tent wept for him.

sentences.zh: 厚本義其心，選勇士三百，隨讜入泗州。

translations.literal: Houben respected his heart and selected three hundred brave men to follow Tan into Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Houben respected his heart and selected three hundred brave men to follow Tan into Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 夜半斬賊柵，大呼，由水門而入，賊軍大駭。

translations.literal: At midnight they cut the rebel palisade, shouted loudly, and entered through the water gate; rebel troops were greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight they cut the rebel palisade, shouted loudly, and entered through the water gate; rebel troops were greatly alarmed.

sentences.zh: 既知援兵入，賊乃退舍，人心遂固。

translations.literal: Once they knew relief troops had entered, the rebels then withdrew; hearts in the city were thereby strengthened.
translations.idiomatic: Once they knew relief troops had entered, the rebels then withdrew; hearts in the city were thereby strengthened.

sentences.zh: 浙西觀察使杜審權遣大將翟行約率軍三千赴援，屯蓮塘驛。

translations.literal: Zhexi Observation Commissioner Du Shenquan dispatched great general Zhai Xingyue leading three thousand troops to aid, encamped at Liantang Station.
translations.idiomatic: Zhexi Observation Commissioner Du Shenquan dispatched great general Zhai Xingyue leading three thousand troops to aid, encamped at Liantang Station.

sentences.zh: 慆欲遣人勞之，將吏皆憚其行。

translations.literal: Tao wished to send men to comfort them; generals and officials all feared the journey.
translations.idiomatic: Tao wished to send men to comfort them; generals and officials all feared the journey.

sentences.zh: 讜曰：「杜相公以大夫宗盟，急難相赴，安得令使者無言而還！」

translations.literal: Tan said, "Vice Minister Du, as a senior clansman in urgent difficulty, came to aid—how can we let the envoy return without a word!"
translations.idiomatic: Tan said, "Vice Minister Du, as a senior clansman in urgent difficulty, came to aid—how can we let the envoy return without a word!"

sentences.zh: 即賫慆書幣，犒其使。

translations.literal: He then bore Tao's letter and gifts and rewarded the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He then bore Tao's letter and gifts and rewarded the envoy.

sentences.zh: 淮南大將李湘率師五千來援，賊詐降，敗於淮口，湘與郭厚本皆為賊所執，自是無援。

translations.literal: Huainan great general Li Xiang led five thousand troops to aid; the rebels feigned surrender and were defeated at Huaikou; Xiang and Guo Houben were both seized by rebels—thereafter there was no relief.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan great general Li Xiang led five thousand troops to aid; the rebels feigned surrender and were defeated at Huaikou; Xiang and Guo Houben were both seized by rebels—thereafter there was no relief.

sentences.zh: 賊並兵急攻，以鐵鎖斷淮流，梯沖雲合，凡周七月，晝夜不息。

translations.literal: Rebels combined forces for urgent attack, using iron chains to block the Huai current; scaling ladders and assault engines converged like clouds—for a full seven weeks day and night without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels combined forces for urgent attack, using iron chains to block the Huai current; scaling ladders and assault engines converged like clouds—for a full seven weeks day and night without cease.

sentences.zh: 乘城之士，不遑寢寐，面目生瘡，軍儲漸少，分食稀粥。

translations.literal: Those who manned the walls had no time to sleep; faces grew sores; military stores gradually dwindled and they divided thin porridge.
translations.idiomatic: Those who manned the walls had no time to sleep; faces grew sores; military stores gradually dwindled and they divided thin porridge.

sentences.zh: 賴讜犯難仗義，求救於淮北諸軍。

translations.literal: They relied on Tan braving hardship and upholding righteousness to beg rescue from armies north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: They relied on Tan braving hardship and upholding righteousness to beg rescue from armies north of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 既而馬舉以大軍至，賊解圍而去。

translations.literal: Soon Ma Ju arrived with a great army and the rebels lifted the siege and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ma Ju arrived with a great army and the rebels lifted the siege and departed.

sentences.zh: 讜無子，猶子山僧、元老等寄在廣陵。

translations.literal: Tan had no sons; nephews the monk Shanseng, Yuangao, and others were lodged at Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: Tan had no sons; nephews the monk Shanseng, Yuangao, and others were lodged at Guangling.

sentences.zh: 每出城，則書二姓名，謂慆曰：「誌之，得嗣為幸。」

translations.literal: Each time he left the city he wrote two names and told Tao, "Record them—if descendants result, it is fortune."
translations.idiomatic: Each time he left the city he wrote two names and told Tao, "Record them—if descendants result, it is fortune."

sentences.zh: 慆益感之。

translations.literal: Tao was the more moved.
translations.idiomatic: Tao was the more moved.

sentences.zh: 賊平，授讜泗州團練判官、侍御史。

translations.literal: When rebels were pacified Tan was appointed regimental adjutant of Sizhou and attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels were pacified Tan was appointed regimental adjutant of Sizhou and attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 慆遷鄭滑節度，讜亦從之，為賓佐。

translations.literal: Tao transferred to Zheng and Hua military commission; Tan also followed as staff member.
translations.idiomatic: Tao transferred to Zheng and Hua military commission; Tan also followed as staff member.

sentences.zh: 慆卒，乃退歸江東，以隱居為事。

translations.literal: When Tao died he then retired to Jiangdong and made seclusion his occupation.
translations.idiomatic: When Tao died he then retired to Jiangdong and made seclusion his occupation.

sentences.zh: 贊

translations.literal: Commentary:
translations.idiomatic: Commentary:

sentences.zh: 贊曰：獸解觸邪，草能指佞。

translations.literal: Beasts can gore evil; grass can point at flatterers.
translations.idiomatic: Beasts can gore evil; grass can point at flatterers.

sentences.zh: 烈士徇義，見危致命。

translations.literal: Martyr-scholars follow righteousness, seeing peril and giving life.
translations.idiomatic: Martyr-scholars follow righteousness, seeing peril and giving life.

sentences.zh: 國有忠臣，亡而復存。

translations.literal: When a state has loyal ministers, though perished it is as if alive.
translations.idiomatic: When a state has loyal ministers, though perished it is as if alive.

sentences.zh: 何以喪邦？

translations.literal: How is a state lost?
translations.idiomatic: How is a state lost?

sentences.zh: 奸邪受恩。

translations.literal: Wicked and treacherous receive favor.
translations.idiomatic: Wicked and treacherous receive favor.
